text: The purpose of this report is to make changes to The Eglinton Way and Upper Village Business Improvement Area Boards of Management, in accordance with the requirements of the City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 19, Business Improvement Areas. The Eglinton Way and Upper Village Business Improvement Areas fall within two Community Council boundaries.

City Council on February 6 and 7, 2024, adopted the following: 1. City Council remove the following directors from the Business Improvement Area Boards of Management set out below: The Eglinton Way: Izeti, Kozeta Upper Village: Aboudi, Yacov (Jacob)
